The '''Rainboh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located off the [[Rynmar Trail]] and the [[Great Rim Route]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Hapan Rim Worlds|Rim Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system received its name from the planet [[Rainboh]], which was situated within it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rainboh system was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
